sources.scope: Released v0.3.2 source: onboarding, installation controls, model discovery/library/settings/chat and update controls.
Unreleased engine overview and advanced registration controls.

method: Unmodified native Tauri WebKitGTK window captures with the real Rust IPC backend; no route, IPC, installed-state, probe or model-response mock.
scope: Observed native Linux desktop UI only. Model-response evidence is scoped per capture. These screenshots do not complete all-engine/device support, F09, full Linux acceptance, or real v0.3.1-to-v0.3.2 update installation/UI acceptance.

inference_evidence.request_text: Write a short welcome message for someone trying a local AI app for the first time.
inference_evidence.response_text: "Welcome to our local AI app! We're excited to introduce you to the world of AI and all its possibilities. Whether you're curious about the latest developments or simply looking to learn more, we have something for everyone. Our app is designed to help you stay informed and engaged with the latest AI trends and innovations. So, whether you're interested in finance, healthcare, or anything in between, we're here to help you make the most of your AI experiences. Join us and explore the world of AI together."
